title: Housing Stability Intervention for Health Improvement
implementation_guidance: Implement a housing stability assessment and intervention protocol; screen all Medicaid patients for housing instability using validated questions about housing security, eviction risk, and homelessness; document housing status in structured fields; create referral pathways to local housing assistance programs; develop relationships with legal aid services for eviction prevention; coordinate with rental assistance programs; maintain updated resource list of emergency housing options; assist patients with housing applications and documentation requirements; follow up within 30 days to assess housing status changes; provide transportation assistance to housing appointments when needed; advocate with landlords when appropriate; document all housing interventions and outcomes.
expected_outcomes: Reduced housing instability, decreased emergency department utilization, improved chronic disease management, better medication adherence, reduced missed appointments, improved mental health outcomes, decreased hospitalization rates, cost savings to Medicaid system.
target_population: Medicaid-enrolled individuals experiencing or at risk of housing instability, particularly those with chronic health conditions, behavioral health diagnoses, or high healthcare utilization patterns.
citation: Taylor LA. Housing and health: an overview of the literature. Health Affairs Health Policy Brief. 2018. doi:10.1377/hpb20180313.396577
